== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used:
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=86 Official Announcement - World Championships 2008] (28 May 2008; [https://web.archive.org/web/20080712072021/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=86 Internet Archive]): venue offer and capacity, travel, Larson's hotel and lodging offer, thanks.
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=98 Worlds 2008 Minneapolis - Schedule] (6 September 2008; [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915055914/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=98 Internet Archive]): entry fees and premium discounts; Sunday Consolation Tournament.
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/news/news.php?id=8 Worlds Blog Coverage!] (8 October 2008; [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225924/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=8 Internet Archive]): blog coverage request (new Coverage section).
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/news/news.php?id=7 10 Questions with Scott Lingrell] (8 October 2008; [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=7 Internet Archive]): ratings to start with this event.
=== Missing data ===
* The announcement thanks "Henry" with no surname. [[Henry Dunn]] was Tournament Advocate at about this time, so it may be him, but the source does not say so; the name is left unlinked.
* The owner of Twin City Comics is named only as "Jay".
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* In the 8 October 2008 interview [[Scott Lingrell]] says he will not be at Worlds, but the Day 2 table lists him with a Day 2 deck pair. Check the Day 2 PDF.

== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added from Players Committee forum posts (refs pcf-…): travel (Jonathan Murray, Casey Anis, Garrett Larson's directions), the decklist scans by [[Tim Simon]] (sheets sent by "Mr. Larson", taken as [[Garrett Larson]], the host), the MPC bye discussion, Fantasy Worlds point values, the World Championships forum board.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* A player posting as Tusken84 wrote on 20 October 2008 that he had "heard rumours" that Jan Westergard played Light Side combat racing at Worlds 2008. The wiki has Westergard's Day 2 Light deck as We'll Handle This; the rumour is hearsay and was not added to the article.
* WiseMarsellus, who set the 2008 Fantasy Worlds point values, is not tied to a full name in the posts (the gap list suggested Tom Hollingworth); left as the handle.
* The "Worlds Consolation event" whose two Day 2 byes simone89 mentions is not dated in the posts (probably 2007); "R Smith"/"Reid" taken as written, not linked.
